input: Fix the cracked grout in the entryway tiles

gold.taskTitle: Repair cracked grout in entryway tile floor
gold.taskDescription: Fix the cracked grout lines in the entryway tile area of the home.

questions.title: How many square feet is the entryway tile area?
questions.description: Understanding the size of the area helps estimate materials and time needed.

questions.title: Is the grout cracked in a few spots or throughout?
questions.description: Knowing whether the damage is isolated or widespread determines the scope of the repair.

questions.title: What color is the existing grout?
questions.description: The grout color must be matched so the repair blends in seamlessly.

questions.title: Is the grout sanded or unsanded?
questions.description: The type of grout used depends on the width of the joints and must be matched.

questions.title: Do you plan to DIY this or hire someone?
questions.description: This determines whether the plan should focus on finding a contractor or buying supplies.

questions.title: Do you have any tools like a grout saw or oscillating tool?
questions.description: Knowing what tools are already on hand affects what needs to be purchased or rented.

questions.title: Is there a deadline, such as an event or home sale?
questions.description: A time constraint will shape how urgently the task needs to be scheduled and completed.
